components.name: golang.org/x/crypto/acme
components.purpose: RFC 8555 ACME protocol client primitives used behind GoreeCloud Gateway-owned certificate orchestration
components.scope: Only package golang.org/x/crypto/acme is imported by Gateway source.
components.selection: Current reviewed golang.org/x/crypto release at this stabilization point. Gateway now uses supported Go 1.27.1 rather than retaining the out-of-support Go 1.24 line solely for dependency compatibility.

known_advisories.justification: Gateway imports only golang.org/x/crypto/acme. Exact-head govulncheck reports zero vulnerabilities in imported packages and zero reachable vulnerabilities; the advisory remains module-visible because it applies to unused OpenPGP subpackages.

components.name: golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck
components.purpose: Reachability-based Go vulnerability scanning for Gateway source and its dependency graph
components.scope: CI-only tool installed at an exact version; not linked into Gateway runtime artifacts.
components.selection: Current reviewed govulncheck release at this stabilization point, run with the exact supported Go version declared by Gateway.
